sources.title: vxvware/saw-best-matrix: shard logs of the n=67 census

gaps: Unpublished; no paper is recorded for this census.
Single complete run; not replayed here.
notes: The archived source file is a deliberately empty census output whose header records the exhaustive search: the corrected wide-word build of the vxvware good-matrix engine (tools/good_c_n67.c in the source repository), validated against the stored n=37 census before each shard, run as 16 resumable shards over two hosts between 2026-10-27 and 2026-11-10, 11.76e12 triples tested and no quadruple. It replaces the partial search recorded as good-n67-campaign and the earlier run withdrawn over the wide-word bug. No published search covers this order.
